stories.title: Integrate Charting Library for Data Visualizations
stories.goal: integrate a robust charting library (Recharts, Chart.js, or D3.js) for creating interactive data visualizations
stories.benefit: the application can render professional, performant charts and graphs without building visualization logic from scratch
acceptanceCriteria: Library is installed and configured in Next.js application with TypeScript support
Library supports responsive design and adapts to different viewport sizes
Library provides accessibility features (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation)
Library handles data updates efficiently without unnecessary re-renders
Library integrates with Tailwind CSS theming for consistent styling
Documentation and examples are available for team reference

stories.title: Build Reusable Line Chart Component
stories.goal: create a reusable line chart component for displaying time-series data like rankings progression
stories.benefit: consistent chart implementation across application with configurable options
acceptanceCriteria: Component accepts data prop with time-series array structure
Component supports multiple data series with distinct visual styling
Component includes configurable axis labels, legends, and tooltips
Component handles missing or incomplete data gracefully
Component provides callback props for interaction events (hover, click)
Component is responsive and adapts to parent container dimensions

stories.title: Create Interactive Bracket Visualization Component
stories.goal: build a flexible bracket visualization component for playoff structures
stories.benefit: playoff brackets display correctly regardless of league configuration or screen size
acceptanceCriteria: Component accepts bracket data structure defining rounds, matchups, and teams
Component dynamically generates bracket layout based on number of teams and rounds
Component displays connection lines between rounds with proper visual hierarchy
Component handles first-round byes and irregular bracket structures
Component supports both winners and losers brackets with visual distinction
Component is responsive with mobile-optimized layout (vertical or collapsible)

stories.title: Implement Calendar View Component for Schedule Display
stories.goal: create a calendar view component for displaying weekly matchups across a season
stories.benefit: users can see season schedule in familiar calendar format with easy week navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays weeks in calendar grid or continuous horizontal layout
Component highlights current week and allows navigation to past/future weeks
Component shows matchups, scores, and key events within each week cell
Component supports season selector to switch between different years
Component handles regular season and playoff weeks with visual distinction
Component is responsive and adapts to mobile viewports effectively

stories.title: Build Data Tooltip System for Charts
stories.goal: see detailed information when hovering over or tapping chart elements
stories.benefit: I can explore data points without cluttering the chart with constant labels
acceptanceCriteria: Tooltips appear on hover (desktop) or tap (mobile) of data points
Tooltips display relevant data values, labels, and contextual information
Tooltips position intelligently to avoid viewport edges and chart overlaps
Tooltips use consistent styling matching application theme
Tooltips include smooth fade-in/fade-out animations
Tooltips are accessible to screen readers with appropriate ARIA attributes

stories.title: Create Chart Legend Component with Toggle Functionality
stories.goal: interact with chart legends to show/hide specific data series
stories.benefit: I can focus on specific teams or data series without visual clutter
acceptanceCriteria: Legend displays all data series with team names, colors, and icons/logos
Clicking legend item toggles visibility of corresponding data series
Legend provides visual feedback for enabled/disabled state (opacity, strikethrough)
Legend includes 'Show All' and 'Hide All' quick actions
Legend position is configurable (top, bottom, left, right, or floating)
Legend is responsive and scrollable if team count exceeds available space

stories.title: Implement Color Scheme System for Visualizations
stories.goal: establish consistent color scheme for charts using team colors or predefined palettes
stories.benefit: visualizations maintain consistent, accessible color usage across all components
acceptanceCriteria: System uses team primary colors when available from league settings
System provides fallback color palette for teams without defined colors
Color palette ensures sufficient contrast for accessibility (WCAG AA)
System supports distinguishing 12+ teams with distinct colors
System provides color utilities for generating tints, shades, and gradients
System integrates with Tailwind CSS theme configuration

stories.title: Build Loading States for Visualization Components
stories.goal: see appropriate loading indicators while chart data is being fetched
stories.benefit: I understand the application is working and know when visualization is ready
acceptanceCriteria: Components display skeleton loaders or placeholder charts during data fetch
Loading states match the approximate dimensions of final visualization
Loading states use consistent animation style (pulse, shimmer, spinner)
Components transition smoothly from loading to data display without layout shift
Error states display informative messages if data fetch fails
Loading indicators are accessible with ARIA live region announcements

stories.title: Create Empty State Displays for Visualizations
stories.goal: see helpful empty state messages when no data is available for visualization
stories.benefit: I understand why a chart is empty and what actions I can take
acceptanceCriteria: Empty states display when no data exists for selected time period or filters
Empty states include descriptive text explaining why data is unavailable
Empty states provide actionable suggestions (e.g., 'Select different time range')
Empty states use consistent visual design with illustration or icon
Empty states handle different scenarios (no published rankings, future weeks, new leagues)
Empty states maintain chart container dimensions to prevent layout shift

stories.title: Implement Chart Export and Download Features
stories.goal: export or download charts as images for sharing outside the application
stories.benefit: I can easily share visualizations on social media or save for records
acceptanceCriteria: Export button available on chart components triggers download action
Charts export as high-quality PNG or SVG format
Exported images include chart title, legend, and data attribution
Export preserves current chart state including filters and visibility toggles
Export works on both desktop and mobile devices
Export functionality handles different chart types consistently

stories.title: Build Responsive Chart Sizing and Scaling
stories.goal: view charts that automatically adjust to my screen size and orientation
stories.benefit: I have optimal viewing experience regardless of device or window size
acceptanceCriteria: Charts use responsive container queries or viewport-relative sizing
Charts maintain aspect ratio while scaling to fit available space
Charts adjust label density, font sizes, and spacing based on container size
Charts provide horizontal scrolling only when necessary (avoid unnecessary overflow)
Charts respond to window resize events with smooth transitions
Charts optimize layout for both portrait and landscape mobile orientations

stories.title: Implement Zoom and Pan Interactions for Complex Charts
stories.goal: zoom into specific areas of charts and pan to explore data in detail
stories.benefit: I can examine crowded chart sections without losing context of full dataset
acceptanceCriteria: Charts support pinch-to-zoom gesture on touch devices
Charts support mouse wheel zoom on desktop with modifier key (Shift or Ctrl)
Charts support click-and-drag panning when zoomed in
Charts display zoom controls (+ / - buttons, reset button) on interface
Charts maintain data point positions accurately during zoom/pan operations
Charts reset to default view when user clicks reset button

stories.title: Create Animated Transitions for Chart Updates
stories.goal: see smooth animated transitions when chart data changes
stories.benefit: I can visually track changes in data and understand updates more intuitively
acceptanceCriteria: Charts animate when switching between time periods or filters
Data points smoothly transition between positions with appropriate easing
New data series fade in, removed series fade out
Animation duration is short enough to feel responsive (200-500ms)
Animations respect user's reduced motion preferences (prefers-reduced-motion)
Animations can be disabled via application settings if needed

stories.title: Build Accessible Chart Components with ARIA Support
stories.goal: access chart data and navigation using screen readers or keyboard
stories.benefit: I can understand visualizations even if I cannot see them
acceptanceCriteria: Charts include descriptive ARIA labels and roles for all interactive elements
Charts provide alternative text descriptions summarizing data trends
Charts support keyboard navigation through data points via Tab and arrow keys
Charts announce data values to screen readers when focused or hovered
Charts include skip-to-content links for bypassing complex visualizations
Charts meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards

stories.title: Implement Data Table Alternative for Charts
stories.goal: toggle between chart visualization and data table view
stories.benefit: I can consume the same information in my preferred format
acceptanceCriteria: Charts include toggle button to switch between visualization and table views
Data table displays same data shown in chart in structured table format
Table includes sorting capabilities on relevant columns
Table is responsive and scrollable on smaller screens
Table is accessible and navigable with keyboard
View preference persists during session or across time range changes

stories.title: Create Team Logo and Avatar Display in Charts
stories.goal: see team logos and avatars within chart visualizations for quick identification
stories.benefit: I can instantly recognize teams without reading labels
acceptanceCriteria: Charts display team logos at key positions (line endpoints, data points, legend)
Logos scale appropriately based on chart size without distortion
System provides fallback icons or initials if team logo is unavailable
Logos maintain visibility and clarity even when chart is zoomed or scaled
Logos are clickable to trigger relevant actions (highlight team, view details)
Logo rendering performs efficiently with multiple teams displayed simultaneously

stories.title: Build Comparison Mode for Visualizations
stories.goal: compare multiple teams or time periods side-by-side in same visualization
stories.benefit: I can analyze differences and trends more effectively
acceptanceCriteria: Charts support selecting multiple teams for comparison via checkboxes or multi-select
Comparison mode highlights selected teams while dimming non-selected teams
Charts provide comparison statistics (difference, percentage change) in tooltips
Comparison mode persists when changing time ranges or filters
System allows comparing up to 4-6 teams simultaneously without cluttering chart
Comparison mode includes clear controls for adding/removing teams from comparison

stories.title: Implement Real-Time Chart Updates for Live Scoring
stories.user: League Member During Active Game Week
stories.goal: see charts update in real-time as scores change during live games
stories.benefit: I have current information without manually refreshing the page
acceptanceCriteria: Charts poll for data updates at appropriate intervals during live scoring periods
Updated data smoothly animates into chart without jarring jumps
System indicates when chart data was last updated with timestamp
User can manually trigger immediate refresh with pull-to-refresh or button
Real-time updates pause when user is interacting with chart to prevent disruption
System optimizes API calls to avoid excessive server load during high-traffic periods

stories.title: Create Annotation System for Charts
stories.goal: add contextual annotations or notes to specific points on charts
stories.benefit: I can highlight important events or provide context for data trends
acceptanceCriteria: Charts support displaying annotation markers at specific data points or time periods
Annotations include text content, optional icons, and timestamp information
System allows commissioners to create public annotations visible to all members
Annotations display on hover/click with detailed information in tooltip or modal
Annotations persist and remain associated with specific weeks/data points
Annotation system integrates with content moderation tools for admins

stories.title: Build Print-Optimized Chart Styles
stories.goal: print charts that render clearly on paper with appropriate sizing
stories.benefit: I can create physical copies of charts for offline viewing or archiving
acceptanceCriteria: Charts use print-specific CSS media queries for print layout
Printed charts adjust colors for optimal visibility on paper (avoid light colors on white)
Charts scale appropriately to fit standard paper sizes (A4, Letter)
Print view removes interactive elements and shows full data table if helpful
Charts maintain legends and labels for context in printed format
Print preview shows accurate representation of final printed output
